## Statutory Guides & Consumer Law Regulations
- [Order XXXVII Summary Suit: The Fast Civil Route to Recover Money](https://www.legalrecovery.in/law/order-37-summary-suit-money-recovery): Fast-track money recovery under Order XXXVII CPC for promissory notes, cheques and written contracts with 10-day appearance rules and court fee calculations.
- [BNS 318 Cheating vs Civil Dispute: When Police Act](https://www.legalrecovery.in/law/bns-318-cheating-vs-civil-dispute): Statutory analysis of BNS Section 318 (old IPC 420) vs civil loan default, dishonest intent from inception, and police complaint vs summary suit.
- [EPF Claim Rejected? EPF Scheme 2026 Timelines & Remedies](https://www.legalrecovery.in/law/epf-scheme-2026-claim-rejection-remedies): Statutory guide on rejected PF claims, member detail mismatches, missing exit dates, EPFiGMS & CPGRAMS escalation, and advocate legal notices.
- [Foreign Employer Not Paying Salary to Indian Remote Worker](https://www.legalrecovery.in/foreign-employer-not-paying-salary-india): Cross-border salary recovery guide for Indian remote workers covering Section 20 CPC jurisdiction, EOR co-liability, and advocate legal notices.
- [Maternity Benefit Not Paid by Employer? Legal Notice](https://www.legalrecovery.in/maternity-benefit-not-paid-legal-notice): Statutory guide on withheld 26 weeks maternity pay, illegal termination during pregnancy under Section 12, Supreme Court precedents (Dr. Kavita Yadav 2024), and advocate legal notices under the Maternity Benefit Act 1961.
- [ESOP Buyback Not Paid to Ex-Employee? Legal Options](https://www.legalrecovery.in/esop-buyback-not-paid-ex-employee): Comprehensive legal guide on recovering unhonoured ESOP buybacks, accrued vested equity rights, and advocate notices under Companies Act 2013 and Contract Act.
- [Delivery or Ride Partner Payout Withheld? Legal Remedies](https://www.legalrecovery.in/gig-worker-payout-withheld-legal-notice): Escalation guide for delivery and ride partners facing blocked app IDs, withheld weekly payouts, bogus negative wallet balances, and advocate legal notices under the Code on Social Security 2020.
- [How to File a Labour Department Complaint Online for Unpaid Salary](https://www.legalrecovery.in/labour-commissioner-complaint-online-salary): State-wise guide to filing an online labour department complaint on SAMADHAN, e-District, Mahakamgar, and e-Karmika for unpaid salary, delayed FnF, and illegal wage deductions.
- [Experience Letter Not Given by Employer? Legal Action](https://www.legalrecovery.in/experience-letter-not-given-legal-action): Statutory guide on employer refusal of experience certificates, Model Standing Orders Rule 16/17, Article 21 livelihood rights, and advocate legal notices.
- [Bonus or Incentive Not Received: Mail to HR (Template)](https://www.legalrecovery.in/templates/bonus-incentive-not-received-mail): Email templates for unpaid bonus, sales incentive, variable pay or commission, including after resignation, with Section 17(2) Code on Wages and Contract Act Section 73 references.

## Consumer Problem & Refund Tracing Guides
- [Flight Delay & Cancellation Compensation in India (Slabs)](https://www.legalrecovery.in/flight-delay-cancellation-compensation-india): Statutory guide to DGCA compensation slabs for cancelled flights, long delays, and denied boarding, with escalation steps when airlines refuse.
- [Refund Successful but Not Received? Trace It With UTR/ARN](https://www.legalrecovery.in/refund-shows-successful-but-not-received): Actionable guide to trace uncredited e-commerce refunds using UTR and ARN codes, resolve bank suspense ledgers, and enforce RBI delay compensation.
- [Refund as Gift Card or Wallet Only: Is It Legal in India?](https://www.legalrecovery.in/refund-as-gift-card-or-wallet-legal): Statutory guide on forced store credits, RBI source account reversal rules, CCPA Dark Patterns bans, and advocate notice escalation.
- [Visa Agent Took Money, No Visa? Refund & Legal Action](https://www.legalrecovery.in/visa-agent-fraud-refund-legal-notice): Statutory guide on recovering immigration consultant fees, voiding non-refundable contract clauses under Section 2(46) CPA 2019, Section 318 BNS cheating FIRs, and advocate legal notices.
- [Credit Shell or Voucher Instead of Refund: Can You Refuse?](https://www.legalrecovery.in/credit-shell-voucher-instead-of-refund-legal): Comprehensive legal guide on refusing forced airline credit shells and travel vouchers under Supreme Court directives and DGCA CAR rules, demanding full cash refund with interest.
- [Recover Money From Ex-Boyfriend or Girlfriend Legally](https://www.legalrecovery.in/recover-money-from-ex-boyfriend-girlfriend): Statutory guide to recovering loans given to romantic partners using WhatsApp proof, Section 18 limitation resets, and Order XXXVII summary suits.
- [Is a UPI Transfer Proof of a Loan? Evidence Explained](https://www.legalrecovery.in/upi-transfer-as-proof-of-loan): Comprehensive legal evidence guide explaining bank transfer proof, Section 63 BSA certification, WhatsApp loan acknowledgments, and Order 37 summary suits.
- [Has Your 3-Year Limit Expired? Acknowledgment & Part-Payment](https://www.legalrecovery.in/limitation-extended-by-acknowledgment-part-payment): Statutory guide on Section 18 WhatsApp acknowledgment and Section 19 part-payment restarting the 3-year limitation clock for personal and business loans.
- [Chit Fund or Kitty Party Money Not Returned? Legal Steps](https://www.legalrecovery.in/chit-fund-kitty-party-money-not-returned): Statutory guide on recovering money from defaulted kitty committees (BCs) and registered chit funds, covering BNS 316/318, the BUDS Act 2019, Section 64 Chit Funds Act arbitration, Order XXXVII summary suits, and advocate legal notices.

- [Stop Payment Cheque Bounce: Is Section 138 Attracted?](https://www.legalrecovery.in/stop-payment-cheque-bounce-case): Comprehensive legal guide explaining Section 138 NI Act liability for payment stopped by drawer return memos under Supreme Court precedents.
- [Cheque Bounced 'Account Closed' or 'Signature Mismatch'](https://www.legalrecovery.in/cheque-bounce-account-closed-signature-mismatch): Legal guide on return reasons (account closed, signature mismatch, refer to drawer, stop payment) and their Section 138 NI Act applicability.
